title: delwrite~

messages.description: signal input into the delay time

arguments.description: length of delay line in ms (the maximum delay time in read objects)

body:
[delwrite~] allocates a delay line with the given name and size in ms, and writes its signal input into it.

[delread~] and [delread4~] read from a delay line allocated in a [delwrite~] object with the same name. More than one of them can read from the same [delwrite~]. If the delay time is longer than the delay line or less than zero, it is clipped to the length of the delay line. Delay names often use "$0" (the patch ID number) to keep them local to a patch.

In case the [delwrite~] runs later in the DSP loop than the [delread~] or [delread4~] objects, the delay is constrained below by one vector length (usually 64 samples).
